description: This file contains a class named `Marketing` in the namespace `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Marketing`. It extends the base controller class and includes methods to handle marketing-related functionalities such as listing and managing marketing campaigns. The class defines the `index`, `list`, and `getList` methods to load language files, handle request filters, build URLs, fetch marketing data from the model, and prepare data for rendering views. It integrates with other components like URL, session, model, and view loader. The file appears to be part of the administrative backend of an OpenCart module and is specifically tailored for managing marketing campaigns.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: A controller class for managing marketing campaigns in the OpenCart admin panel. It handles the display of marketing lists, filtering, sorting, pagination, and creation/editing of marketing entries.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial entry point that loads language settings, sets page title, processes filters from the request, and renders the main marketing view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Loads language, fetches marketing list data, and outputs the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Constructs filters from request parameters, fetches marketing records from the model, prepares data for the view, including sorting links, pagination, and action URLs.
